items.title: Emile Barnes Interview, 1960-08-22
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Did you ever see much difference between the wood and the hard rubber, Miele, to make any difference to you?

ctx.x: That's wood, I think. That's wood, yeah. See if it's about in it.
